description: Block C3 — CPU/DDR collision: four CPU-heavy biologically-valid agents launched simultaneously (offset=0). Tasks replaced from fake ML tasks to real Biomni domain tools. All four have long CPU execute phases that will overlap, competing for DDR bandwidth and CPU cores. Expected result: execute times inflate vs single-agent baselines (DDR contention); cpu_mean spikes; gpu_bubble_frac drops for all (GPU filled by concurrent inference during initial generate phases). Key metrics: per-agent execute_total_s vs baseline, cpu_max, cpu_hot_cores during execute, TPOT across all agents.
